name: Dispatch on Nebius

NEBIUS_API_KEY.description: Your Nebius Token Factory API key. Dispatch's router and coding agent run on Nebius models.

DISPATCH_PASSWORD.description: A password you choose (8+ characters) to sign in to Dispatch. Leave empty and one is generated for you.

postCreateCommand: npm ci && (command -v python3 >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3))
